name: connector-cloudflare-observability
title: Cloudflare Observability
description: Inspect recent Worker logs, exceptions, requests, and traces from a connected Cloudflare account or Worker.

binding.name: CLOUDFLARE_OBSERVABILITY
binding.title: Cloudflare Worker
binding.description: Choose the Worker whose logs and telemetry this workspace should inspect.

name: connector-confluence
title: Confluence Knowledge Hub
description: Search and browse pages across a connected Confluence site from one focused knowledge workspace.

binding.name: CONFLUENCE
binding.title: Confluence site
binding.description: Choose the Confluence site whose spaces and pages this workspace should search.

name: connector-email-inbox
title: Email Intake Inbox
description: Receive routed email into a durable, searchable inbox suitable for requests, leads, and automated intake.

binding.name: EMAIL
binding.title: Email mailbox
binding.description: Choose the CinaSeek mailbox that should receive messages for this inbox.

name: connector-github
title: GitHub Delivery Desk
description: Review repository issues and pull requests, search work, and submit new issues through approval-aware actions.

binding.name: GITHUB
binding.title: GitHub repository
binding.description: Choose the repository whose issues and pull requests this workspace should manage.

name: connector-google-drive
title: Google Drive Navigator
description: Browse and search metadata for files and folders visible to a connected Google Drive account.

binding.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE
binding.title: Google Drive account
binding.description: Choose the Google account whose accessible Drive metadata this workspace should search.

name: connector-home-assistant
title: Home Assistant Control Room
description: Monitor entities and safely submit common device controls to a connected Home Assistant instance.

binding.name: HOME_ASSISTANT
binding.title: Home Assistant instance
binding.description: Choose the Home Assistant instance whose entities this control room should use.

name: connector-linear
title: Linear Workboard
description: Search and triage issues across a connected Linear workspace and submit new work for approval.

binding.name: LINEAR
binding.title: Linear workspace
binding.description: Choose the Linear workspace whose teams and issues this workboard should manage.

name: connector-mcp
title: MCP Tool Console
description: Discover the tools exposed by any connected MCP server and run read or approval-gated operations with JSON arguments.

binding.name: MCP_SERVER
binding.title: MCP server
binding.description: Connect the HTTPS MCP endpoint whose granted tools this console should expose.

name: connector-notion
title: Notion Content Hub
description: Search pages and databases shared with a connected Notion workspace and open source content in context.

binding.name: NOTION
binding.title: Notion workspace
binding.description: Choose the Notion workspace whose shared pages and databases this hub should search.

name: connector-slack
title: Slack Conversation Finder
description: Browse channels and search messages across a connected Slack workspace without exposing unrelated credentials.

binding.name: SLACK
binding.title: Slack workspace
binding.description: Choose the Slack workspace whose channels and messages this finder should read.

name: connector-spotify
title: Spotify Library Desk
description: Search music, browse playlists, and submit playback or playlist actions through a connected Spotify account.

binding.name: SPOTIFY
binding.title: Spotify account
binding.description: Choose the Spotify account whose library and playback this desk should use.

name: connector-supabase
title: Supabase Project Inspector
description: Inspect project health, database tables, functions, and storage, with an approval-gated SQL action surface.

binding.name: SUPABASE
binding.title: Supabase project
binding.description: Choose the Supabase project whose database and services this inspector should access.

name: connector-workers-ai
title: Workers AI Model Lab
description: Exercise a user-owned Workers AI embedding, image, speech, or classification model from a focused model workspace.

binding.name: WORKERS_AI_MODEL
binding.title: Workers AI model
binding.description: Choose one embeddings, image, speech, TTS, or classification model from your Cloudflare account.

name: connector-zoominfo
title: ZoomInfo Account Explorer
description: Search company records and review account credit usage before requesting enrichment actions.

binding.name: ZOOMINFO
binding.title: ZoomInfo account
binding.description: Choose the ZoomInfo account this explorer should search.
